_note: AUTHORED. Text is registered as a root-level node with capability display (owner decisions of 2026-10-25, DEC-096); fallback follows DEC-080. a11y and responsive state only what the source does. Text has no component-token layer, so tokenRoles maps its tone and type roles to the semantic tokens Text.module.css reads.

hiddenProps.ref: A React ref has no protocol form.

a11y.element: Renders a native element with no role override; as picks it, so a heading level fits the page outline whatever the visual role.
a11y.colour: Tone never carries meaning alone: Text has no status tones.

responsive.breakpoints: Heading and title sizes step up with the responsive type collection (--atlas-text-h3 and --atlas-text-h4); no layout change.
